word.definition: A bon vivant is a sociable person who has refined tastes especially with respect to food and drink.

sports_fact.text: On October 18, 1977, Reggie Jackson hit three home runs on three consecutive pitches — off three different pitchers — to clinch the World Series. 'Mr. October' was born.

market.headline: The AI Stock Market Wobble Is a Reminder: This Time Isn’t Different
market.summary: The artificial intelligence build-out hasn’t shown it can avoid the problems of past massive capital projects, such as railways and the internet.

quote.text: No fearless fool now fronts thee. I own thy speechless, placeless power; but to the last gasp of my earthquake life will dispute its unconditional, unintegral mastery in me. In the midst of the personified impersonal, a personality stands here.
quote.author: Herman Melville

history.text: German Autumn: A set of events revolving around the kidnapping of Hanns Martin Schleyer and the hijacking of a Lufthansa flight by the Red Army Faction (RAF) comes to an end when Schleyer is murdered and various RAF members allegedly commit suicide.
